literal_subject_leads.ack_text:
We wish to thank Charles Doran, Bertrand Eynard, and Nicolas Orantin for helpful conversations. We wish to thank Motohico Mulase and Yongbin Ruan for encouragement.
We wish to thank Sheldon Katz, Jie Zhou, and Shengmao Zhu for their comments on earlier versions of this paper.
The first author is partially supported by a start-up grant at
Peking University. The second author is partially supported by NSF grants DMS-1206667 and DMS-1159416. The third author is partially supported by the start-up grant at Tsinghua University.

The authors would like to thank    Prakash Belkale, Boris Shapiro, Michael Shapiro and Lei Song for helpful discussions.  The authors are extremely grateful to    Leonardo C. Mihalcea
 for his valuable comments. The authors would also like to thank the anonymous reviewers for the careful reading of our manuscript and  their valuable  comments.

The first author would like to express the deepest gratitude to Prof. Bumsig Kim (1968-2021) for his mentorship. As suggested by Prof. Bumsig Kim, the first author learned  both quantum K-theory and Seidel elements for the first time, while he was a postdoc at KIAS.
The first author  was  supported by   the National Key Research and Development Program of China No.~2023YFA100980001 and NSFC Grant 12271529.
